'''''The Wrath of IG-88''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which took place during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It depicted a unit of the [[IG-88 assassin droid/Legends|IG-88]] [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] line and members of his droid [[IG-88's Droid Army|army]], including [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]] and [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]], on the offensive, with several droid parts&mdash;including pieces to a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]&mdash;scattered among his feet. The IG-88 droid was holding a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] in his right hand while firing a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] from his left. The painting had an overall [[Color/Legends|blue]] tone to it while IG-88's blaster bolt was green. The painting was available for purchase from the [[City/Legends|township]] of [[Aurilia]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] to individuals who had proven themselves an asset and hero to the people of the town.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''The Wrath of IG-88'' was a painting available to players of the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]]. It could be purchased by the player from vendors in Aurilia for one "Droid Factory Token of Heroism", a currency players received each time they completed the "Droid Factory" heroic encounter. The painting was added to the game on [[November 1]], [[2007]] as part of the ''Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes'' game update. It could be used in the player's house as decoration.
